name: Homemade Cup Noodle Jars
desc: Make-ahead ramen jars layered with a miso soy base, vegetables and instant noodles; add boiling water to eat.

source.title: Homemade Cup Noodle Jars
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: Per jar (makes 3; use wide-mouth 32 oz jars):
1 portion instant-style ramen noodles that cook in hot water (seasoning packet not used)
ingredients.note: cooks in hot water; seasoning packet not used

ingredients.raw: About 2 cups boiling water, to serve
1 1/2 cups shelled edamame, thawed if frozen
Optional: corn, bok choy, spinach, mushrooms, peppers, bamboo shoots, cabbage, peas

steps: Put the soy sauce, miso, ginger, and any chili crisp or sugar in the bottom of each jar.
Divide the vegetables into thirds and add one third to each jar.
Set one portion of dry noodles on top, seal, and refrigerate up to 5 days.
To eat, pour in enough boiling water to cover the noodles. Cover loosely (a napkin works; do not screw the lid on tight) and wait the time on the noodle package. Stir well to dissolve the miso.
tips: Bean sprouts only last 2-3 days; add them closer to eating if prepping for the full week.
Let a cold jar sit out 15 min or rinse the outside with warm water before adding boiling water so the glass does not crack.
